description:
Release freeze (G7) is in force from the start of dlv2-40 until this item finishes; the legacy release path remains the fallback.
Agent (pre-approved): run make release-prep VERSION=<next>rc1 (or the repo's pre-release convention), where <next> is the first version after 0.4.2. Merge the release-prep PR and wait for its trunk.yml push run on develop to finish green. Tag that merge commit, and run release-v2 to TestPyPI. Compare the published hashes against the SHA256SUMS of the admitted trunk dist-artifact for that commit, and check that pip install from TestPyPI works on all T4 cells. Then run make release-prep VERSION=<next>, merge it, and STOP: report readiness (rehearsal evidence, candidate commit, hashes) to the owner. EXPECTED STOP: the owner creates the v<next> tag and/or approves the `pypi` environment deployment. After the owner's release, the agent verifies hashes, attestation, and pypi-latest installability (t3:install) and finishes the item.
A green nightly T3 run (dlv2-22) is required before a real PyPI release.
